'''Sashal''' was a [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], one whom sat on their [[Circle of Lords]]. According to a source, Sashal was a petite woman, and according to [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]], she was stupid. However, she was an intelligent and powerful woman, hence she served on the Circle of Lords, despite her small stature.<ref name="Ascension" />
During the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Liberation of Coruscant]] Sashal was one of the many Sith besieged inside the [[New Jedi Temple]]. There during the [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|final battle]] the Sith Lady led a group of fellow Sith to try to kill [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] under advise of [[Vestara Khai]], but they failed, and Sashal and all her fellow Sith were killed.<ref name="Apocalypse" />
